owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

adjustedCollateralValue(address).notice: Total collateral value in USD (18 decimals), adjusted by liqThreshold

depositCollateral(address,uint256).notice: Deposit whitelisted collateral into your vault

getVaultOwners().notice: Get all vault owners (for off-chain indexing)

healthFactor(address).notice: Health factor: WAD = 1.0. Below WAD = liquidatable.

liquidate(address,uint256,address).notice: Liquidate an undercollateralized vault.         Liquidator repays `debtToRepay` USDAX and receives collateral + bonus.

maxMintable(address).notice: Max USDAX mintable given current collateral (before fee)

rawCollateralValue(address).notice: Raw (unadjusted) collateral value in USD (18 decimals)

setOracle(address).notice: Swap the price oracle (owner only — for oracle upgrades/migrations).         New oracle must implement IUSDAxOracle with getPrice() returning 18-dec USD prices.

withdrawCollateral(address,uint256).notice: Withdraw collateral (only if HF stays safe after withdrawal)
